faqs.question: How do I know if I have a clothes moth infestation in my Jersey City home?
faqs.answer: Signs of clothes moth infestation include small irregular holes in wool clothing, cashmere sweaters, or carpets; silky tubes or cases on fabric surfaces; adult moths flying near closets or windows; and webbing in the corners of closets or drawers. You may also notice larvae (small cream-colored worms) on affected fabrics. Our Jersey City technicians provide free phone assessments to confirm the presence and extent of clothes moth activity.
